title: check-verification-forwards
responsibility: Validates that deprecated verification compatibility forwards remain registered, preserve their UIDs, and resolve to existing canonical targets.

inputs.name: checkVerificationForwards.root
inputs.description: Repository root directory that every registered path and target is resolved against: the check reads scripts/verification-forward-registry.json under it, reads each registered source and target file, and scans its compatibility roots for discovered forwards. A root whose registry is absent, unreadable or not valid JSON, or a non-string root, makes the check return the single issue 'scripts/verification-forward-registry.json is missing or invalid' instead of throwing.

outputs.name: checkVerificationForwards
outputs.description: Human-readable issue strings in registry order, followed by one issue for each discovered compatibility forward that no registry entry lists; an empty array means every registered entry passes and every discovered forward is registered. A missing, invalid or unsupported-shape registry returns a one-element array containing only that registry issue.
examples: src/utils/verifyPlan.ts is a compatibility forward missing from scripts/verification-forward-registry.json

errors.name: Verification forward inspection failure
errors.description: Thrown when a registered source or target path, or a module reached by following relative export declarations, exists but cannot be read, for example because it is a directory or is unreadable. Missing registered source or target files and an invalid or unsupported registry are reported as issue text instead.

errors.name: Malformed verification forward entry
errors.description: Thrown when a forward registry entry is null, or when its path or target is not a string, because the check reads each entry's target and joins its path and target into file paths.
